source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: shape value is settled by running 'Explain a repeated numerical pattern by rewriting the terms as': For the fraction pattern 1/3, (1 + 3)/(5 + 7), and (1 + 3 + 5)/(7 + 9 + 11), the — on the item about Treat each shape in an algebra grid as one unknown.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Shape value is computed by squaring row sum and leaving shape value linear, so the written value is 81 — on the item about Treat each shape in an algebra grid as one unknown.

intelligence.enrichment: In an algebra grid, the last column gives the sum of the values to its left; three identical blue squares totaling 27 make one blue square equal to 9, and then two red circles plus 9 totaling 19 make one red circle equal to 5.
